signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage.

evidence.quote: You never pay per run, per page, or per capture. Run 10 or 10 million automations; the price stays the same.
The Free Community License gives you 1 device, 1 active project, and unlimited runs.

signals.label: Support complaints
signals.finding: 6 reviews (5.2% of all) say support is slow or gone.

evidence.quote: available support, and product education are a 1/10.
I have been waiting for support for two weeks.
No one replies to the tickets.

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The cheapest tier is a usable slice of the product.

signals.label: Vendor age & track record
signals.finding: Domain is about 6.7 years old. Sold on AppSumo once before.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $109 vs a stated $1099 regular price (90% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change the service.

exhibits.argument: The pricing page states buyers pay once and own the license forever.

trials.claim: Offers lifetime support including software and billing assistance
trials.claimQuote: RTILA offers lifetime support for its users, including software and billing assistance.
trials.reasoning: Reviews conflict evenly on whether support responds, and none of the exhibits prove lifetime duration or billing assistance specifically.

exhibits.argument: A buyer confirms the team responded quickly to workflow questions, supporting software assistance.

trials.claim: Buyers can compile bots into sellable software
trials.claimQuote: Compile your bots into software you can sell.
trials.reasoning: Lifetime plans require an Enterprise upgrade for standalone bot export and reselling is prohibited unless the tier explicitly includes reseller rights, materially limiting the claim for deal buyers.

exhibits.quote: Standalone bot export included with monthly plans. Lifetime plans: upgrade to Enterprise for standalone bot export.
exhibits.argument: Most lifetime plans do not include bot compilation without an Enterprise upgrade.

exhibits.quote: Reselling the base RTILA X software is prohibited unless your license tier explicitly includes reseller rights.
exhibits.argument: Reselling is prohibited unless the specific license tier includes reseller rights.

exhibits.quote: compile them into standalone software you can sell.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states automations compile into standalone software you can sell.

exhibits.quote: compile them into standalone software you own and can rebrand and sell (insane).

trials.claim: RTILA X compiles workflows into white-label standalone executables for resale
trials.claimQuote: RTILA X is the only cross-platfrom automation tool that compiles your workflows into standalone executables you can white-label and sell to clients.
trials.reasoning: For lifetime buyers, standalone executable export is restricted to Enterprise only and compilation rights depend on the active license tier, despite the general white-label capability described in marketing.

exhibits.quote: Standalone bot export is included on all monthly plans but only Enterprise lifetime includes it.
exhibits.argument: White-label executable export for lifetime buyers is restricted to Enterprise lifetime only.

exhibits.quote: Standalone bot export gives you a license to compile and distribute your automations as independent executables under the terms of your active license tier.
exhibits.argument: Compilation and distribution rights are limited by the active license tier.

exhibits.quote: RTILA X can compile your automation into a standalone executable that runs independently of RTILA X.
exhibits.argument: The vendor confirms compiling automations into standalone executables.

exhibits.quote: Add password protection, white-label branding, and sell it to your clients.
exhibits.argument: The vendor confirms white-label branding and resale to clients.

trials.claim: Includes 100% local-first AI with natural interaction and checkpoint-resume
trials.claimQuote: Combined with 100% local-first AI, natural interaction patterns and checkpoint-resume reliability.
trials.reasoning: The vendor states RTILA X runs entirely on the user's computer and automatically saves checkpoints during every run; the optional cloud AI exhibit does not show cloud use by default.

exhibits.quote: Cloud AI models are optional and only used when you explicitly choose them.
exhibits.argument: AI is not 100% local-first because cloud AI models are used.

exhibits.quote: I also have started to "run" a project and it stops and shuts down the browser midway through the project run.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports runs stop midway, undermining checkpoint-resume reliability.

exhibits.quote: RTILA X runs entirely on your computer, lets you own your automations, and turns your workflows into products
exhibits.argument: The vendor confirms local-first execution entirely on the computer.

exhibits.quote: RTILA X automatically saves checkpoints during every run.
exhibits.argument: The vendor confirms automatic checkpoint saving during runs.
